# viettelcloud_lb_l7_rule (Resource)

Manage a Viettel Cloud Load Balancer L7 Rule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "viettelcloud_lb_l7_rule" "path_rule" {
  l7_policy    = { id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000" }
  type         = "PATH"
  compare_type = "STARTS_WITH"
  value        = "/api"
}

resource "viettelcloud_lb_l7_rule" "header_rule" {
  l7_policy    = { id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000" }
  type         = "HEADER"
  compare_type = "EQUAL_TO"
  key          = "X-Custom-Header"
  value        = "my-value"
  invert       = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `compare_type` (String) Comparison type: CONTAINS, ENDS_WITH, EQUAL_TO, REGEX, or STARTS_WITH.
- `l7_policy` (Attributes) L7 policy that owns the L7 rule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--l7_policy))
- `type` (String) Rule type: HOST_NAME, PATH, FILE_TYPE, HEADER, or COOKIE.
- `value` (String) Value to compare against.

### Optional

- `invert` (Boolean) Whether to invert the rule match. Defaults to false.
- `key` (String) Key to match against. Required when type is HEADER or COOKIE.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the L7 rule was created (RFC3339).
- `id` (String) L7 Rule ID (UUID).
- `provisioning_status` (String) Current provisioning status of the L7 rule.
- `status` (String) Current operating status of the L7 rule.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the L7 rule was last updated (RFC3339).

<a id="nestedatt--l7_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `l7_policy`

Required:

- `id` (String) L7 policy ID (UUID).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a load balancer L7 rule using composite ID: <l7_policy_id>/<l7_rule_id>
terraform import viettelcloud_lb_l7_rule.example 6f1a2c3d-4e5b-6789-abcd-ef0123456789/11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555
```
